paite: Huchia Mosiin biakbuk a lam khiata, thau a nilh khita, ahihsiangthou khita, a van tengteng leh a maitam leh a tuiumbelsuan tengteng thau nilha, ahihsiangthou niin hichi ahi a;
english: It happened on the day that Moses had finished setting up the tabernacle, and had anointed it and sanctified it, with all its furniture, and the altar with all its vessels, and had anointed and sanctified them;

paite: Israelte intekpen, a inkuan ua intekpenten thillat a lan ua, huaite bela nam ua intekpente, a simte uh tunga omte ahi uh:
english: that the princes of Israel, the heads of their fathers’ houses, offered. These were the princes of the tribes. These are they who were over those who were numbered:

paite: A thillatte uh kangtalai tungnei guk leh bawngtal sawm leh nih, intekpen nihin kangtalai khat jel, khatin bawngtal khat jel TOUPA maah a hontawi ua, biakbuk bulah a honglan uhi.
english: and they brought their offering before Yahweh, six covered wagons, and twelve oxen; a wagon for every two of the princes, and for each one an ox: and they presented them before the tabernacle.

paite: Huan, TOUPAN Mosi houpiha,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: Biakbuk nasep dingin a phatuam kha ding, nana la chiat un; Levite, a nasep uh dungjui bangjelin na pe chiat ding hi, chiin
english: “Accept these from them, that they may be used in doing the service of the Tent of Meeting; and you shall give them to the Levites, to every man according to his service.”

paite: Huchiin Mosiin kangtalaite leh bawngtalte a laa, Levite a pia,
english: Moses took the wagons and the oxen, and gave them to the Levites.

paite: Kangtalaite nih leh bawngtalte li Gerson tapate a nasep uh dungjui jelin a pia:
english: He gave two wagons and four oxen to the sons of Gershon, according to their service:

paite: Huan, kangtalai li leh bawngtal giat, siampu Aron tapa Ithamar te Merari tapate a nasep uh dungjui jelin a pia,
english: and he gave four wagons and eight oxen to the sons of Merari, according to their service, under the direction of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

paite: Kohath tapate bel a pe tei kei; mun siangthou nasep amau tuam ahia, a zona zong sek ahi uh.
english: But to the sons of Kohath he gave none, because the service of the sanctuary belonged to them; they carried it on their shoulders.

paite: Intekpenten thaunilh niin maitam latna dinga a thillatte uh maitam bulah a lan uh.
english: The princes gave offerings for the dedication of the altar in the day that it was anointed, even the princes gave their offerings before the altar.

paite: Huan, TOUPAN Mosi kiangah, Intekpen chihin maitam latna dinga thillat, a thillat uh amau tan hi jel dingin lan ding uhi, a chi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “They shall offer their offering, each prince on his day, for the dedication of the altar.”

paite: Ni khat nia a thillat a lan ding mi Juda chi Aminadab tapa Nason ahi:
english: He who offered his offering the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah,

paite: A thillat dangkasik kuang khat, a gikdan sekel ja leh sawmthum, mun siangthoua sekel sawmsagih toh kikima gik dangkasik belhbu khat, tangbuang thillat dingin thau helsa tangbuang nel mahmaha dim tuaktuak;
english: and his offering was: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

paite: Sekel sawm toh kikima gik gimlima dim dangkaeng keu khat;
english: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

paite: Halmang thillat dingin bawngtal tuai khat, belamtal khat, belamnou apa kum khata up khat;
english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

paite: Khelh thoihna dingin keltal khat;
english: one male goat for a sin offering;

paite: Huan, lemna kithoih thillat dingin bawngtal nih, belamtal nih, belamtal nga, keltal nga, belamnou apa kum khata upa nga: hiaite Aminadab tap Nason thillatte ahi uh.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

paite: Ni nih niin Isakarte intekpenten Zuar tapa Nathanelin a lana:
english: On the second day Nethanel the son of Zuar, prince of Issachar, gave his offering.

paite: A thillat dingin dangkasik kuang khat a gikdan sekel ja leh sawmthum, mun siangthoua sekel sawmsagih toh kikima gik dankasik belhbu khat, tangbuang thillat ding thau toh hel tangbuang nel mahmah dim tuaktuak;
english: He offered for his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

paite: Sekel sawm toh kikima gik gimlima dim dangkaeng keu khat;
english: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

paite: Halmang thillat dingin bawngtal tuai khat belamtal khat, belamnou apa kum khata upa khat;
english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

paite: Khelh thoihna dingin keltal khat;
english: one male goat for a sin offering;

paite: Huan, lemna kithoihna thillat dingin bawngtal nih, belamtal nga, keltal nga, belamnou apa kum khata upa nga a lana. Hiai Zuar tapa Nathanel thillatte ahi.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Nethanel the son of Zuar.

paite: Ni thum niin Zebulun tate intekpen Helon tapa Eliabin a lana:
english: On the third day Eliab the son of Helon, prince of the children of Zebulun

paite: A thillat dangkasik kuang khat, a gikdan sekel ja leh sawmthum, mun siangthoua sekel sawmsagih toh kikima gik dangkasik belhbu khat; tangbang thillat ding thau toh jel tangbuang nel mahmaha dim tuaktuak;
english: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was a hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

paite: Sekel sawm toh kikima gik gimlima dim dangkaeng keu khat;
english: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

paite: Halmang thillat ding bawngtal tuai khat, belamtal khat, belamnou apa kum khata upa khat;
english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

paite: Khelh thoihna dingin keltal khat;
english: one male goat for a sin offering;

paite: Huan, lemna kithoih thillat dingin bawngtal nih, belamtal nga, keltal nga, belamnou apa kum khata upa nga ahi. Hiaite Helon tapa Eliab thillatte ahi uh.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Eliab the son of Helon.

paite: Ni li niin Reuben tate intekpen Sedeur tapa Elizurin a lana:
english: On the fourth day Elizur the son of Shedeur, prince of the children of Reuben

paite: A thillat dangkasik kuang khat a gikdan sekel ja leh sawmthum, mun siangthoua sekel sawmsagih toh kikima gik dankasik belhbu khat, tangbuang thillat dinga thau hel tangbuang nel mahmaha dim tuaktuak;
english: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

paite: Sekel sawm toh kikima gik gimlima dim dangkaeng keu khat;
english: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

paite: Halmang thillat ding bawngtal tuai khat, belamtal khat, belamnou apa kum khata up khat;
english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

paite: Khelh thoihna ding keltal khat;
english: one male goat for a sin offering;

paite: Huan, lemna kihthoihna thillat dingin bawngtal nih, belamtal nga, keltal nga, belamnou apa kum khata upa nga ahi. Hiaite Sedeur tapa Elizur thillatte ahi.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Elizur the son of Shedeur.

paite: Ni nga niin Simeon tate intekpen Zurisadai tapa Selumielin a lana:
english: On the fifth day Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai, prince of the children of Simeon

paite: A thillat dangkasik kuang khat, a gikdan sekel ja leh sawmthum; mun siangthou sekel sawmsagih toh kikima gik dangkasik belhbu khat; tangbuang thillat dingin thau toh hel tangbuang nel mahmaha dim tuaktuak;
english: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

paite: Sekel sawm toh kikima gik gimlima dim dangkaeng keu khat;
english: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

paite: Halmang thillat lat dingin bawngtal tuai khat, belamtal khat, belamnou apa kum khata upa khat;
english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

paite: Khelh thoihna ding keltal khat;
english: one male goat for a sin offering;

paite: Huan, lemna kithoih thillat ding bawngtal nih, belamtal nga, keltal nga, belamnou apa kum khata upa nga ahi; hiai Zurisadai tapa Selumiel thillatte ahi.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old: this was the offering of Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

paite: Ni guk niin Gad tate intekpen Deuel tapa Eliasaphin a lana:
english: On the sixth day, Eliasaph the son of Deuel, prince of the children of Gad

paite: A thillat dangkasik kuang khat, a gikdan sekel ja leh sawmthum, mun siangthoua sekel sawmsagih toh kikima gik dangkasik belhbu khat, tangbuang thillat ding thau toh hel tangbuang nel mahmah dim tuaktuak;
english: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

paite: Sekel sawm toh kikima gik gimlima dim dangkaeng keu khat;
english: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

paite: Halmang thillat ding bawngtal tuai khat, belamtal khat, belamnou apa kum khata upa, khat;
english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

paite: Khelh thoihna ding keltal khat;
english: one male goat for a sin offering;

paite: Huan, lemna kithoih thillat ding bawngtal nih, belamtal nga, keltal nga, belamnou apa kum khata upa nga ahi. Hiaite Deuel tapa Eliasaph thillatte ahi.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

paite: Ni sagih niin Ephraim tate intekpen Amihud tapa Eliasamin a lana:
english: On the seventh day Elishama the son of Ammihud, prince of the children of Ephraim

paite: A thillat dangkasik kuang khat, a gikdan sekel ja leh sawmthum, khat, mun siangthoua sekel sawmsagih toh kikima gik dangkasik belhbu khat; halmang thillat ding thau toh hel tangbuang nel mahmah dim tuaktuak;
english: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

paite: Sekel sawm toh kikima gik gimlima dim dangkaeng keu khat;
english: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

paite: Halmang thillat ding bawngtal tuai khat, belamtal khat, belamnou apa kum khata upa, khat;
english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

paite: Khelh thoihna ding keltal khat;
english: one male goat for a sin offering;

paite: Huan, lemna kithoih thillat ding bawngtal nih, belamtal nga, keltal nga, belamnou apa kum khata upa nga ahi: hiaite Amihud tapa Eliasam thillatte ahi.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Elishama the son of Ammihud.

paite: Ni giat niin Manase tate intekpen Pendazur tapa Gamalielin a lana:
english: On the eighth day Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur, prince of the children of Manasseh

paite: A thillat dangkasik kuang khat, a gikdan sekel ja leh sawnthum, mun siangthoua sekel sawmsagih toh kikima gik dangkasik belhbu khat; tangbuang thillat ding thau toh hel, tangbuang nel mahmah a dim tuaktuak;
english: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

paite: Sekel sawm toh kikima gik gimlima dim dangkaeng keu khat;
english: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

paite: Halmang thillat ding bawngtal tuai khat, belamtal khat, belamnou apa kum khata upa khat;
english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

paite: Khelh thoihna ding keltal khat;
english: one male goat for a sin offering;

paite: Huan, lemna kihthoih thillat ding bawngtal nih, belamtal nga, keltal nga, belamnou apa kum khata upa nga ahi. Hiaite Pendazur tapa Gameliel thillatte ahi.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

paite: Ni kua niin Benjamin tate intekpen Gideoni tapa Abidanin a lana;
english: On the ninth day Abidan the son of Gideoni, prince of the children of Benjamin

paite: A thillat dangkasik kuang khat, a gikdan sekel ja leh sawmthum, mun siangthoua sekel sawmsagih toh kikima gik dangkasik belhbu khat, tangbuang thillat ding thau toh hel tangbuang nel mahmaha dim tuaktuak.
english: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

paite: Sekel sawm toh kima gik gimlima dim dangkaeng keu khat;
english: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

paite: Halmang thillat ding bawngtal tuai khat, belamtal khat, belam nou a pa kum khat a upa;
english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

paite: Khelh thoihna ding keltal khat;
english: one male goat for a sin offering;

paite: Huan, lemna kithoihna thillat ding bawngtal nih, belamtal nga, keltal nga, belamnou apa kum khata upa nga ahi: hiaite Gideoni tapa Abidan thillat ahi.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Abidan the son of Gideoni.

paite: Ni sawm niin Dan tate intekpen Amisadai tapa Ahiezerin a lana:
english: On the tenth day Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai, prince of the children of Dan

paite: A thillat dangkasik kuang khat, a gikdan sekel ja leh sawmthum, khat, mun siangthoua sekel sawmsagih toh kikima gik dangkasik belhbu khat, tangbuang thillat ding thau toh hel tangbuang nel mahmaha dim tuaktuak;
english: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

paite: Sekel sawm toh kikima gik gimlima dim dangkaeng keu khat;
english: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

paite: Halmang thillat ding bawngtal tuai khat, belamtal khat, belamnou apa kum khata upa khat;
english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

paite: Khelh thoihna ding keltal khat;
english: one male goat for a sin offering;

paite: Huan, lemna kithoih thillat ding bawngtal nih, belamtal nga, keltal nga, belamnou apa kum khata upa nga ahi: Hiaite Amisadai tapa Ahiezer thillatte ahi.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

paite: Ni sawm leh ni khat niin Aser tate intekpen Okran tapa Pagielin a lana:
english: On the eleventh day Pagiel the son of Ochran, prince of the children of Asher

paite: A thillat dangkasik kuang khat, a gikdan sekel sawmthum, khat, mun siangthoua sekel sawmsagih toh kikima gik dangkasik belhbu khat, tangbuang thillat ding thau toh hel tangbuang nel mahmaha dim tuaktuak;
english: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

paite: Sekel sawm toh kikima gik gimlima dim dangka keu khat;
english: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

paite: Halmang thillat ding bawngtal tuai khat, belamtal khat, belamnou apa kum khata upa khat;
english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

paite: Khelh thoihna ding keltal khat;
english: one male goat for a sin offering;

paite: Huan, lemna kithoih thillat ding bawngtal nih, belamtal nga, keltal nga, belamnou apa kum khat upa nga ahi: hiaite Okran tapa Pagiel thillatte ahi.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Pagiel the son of Ochran.

paite: Ni sawm leh ni nih niin Naphtali tate intekpen Enan tapa Ahirin a lana;
english: On the twelfth day Ahira the son of Enan, prince of the children of Naphtali

paite: A thillat dangkasik kuang khat, a gikdan sekel ja leh sawmthum, khat, mun siangthoua sekel sawmsagih toh kikima gik dangkasik belhbu khat, tangbuang thillat ding thau toh hel tangbuang toh hel tangbuang nel mahmaha dim tuaktuak;
english: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

paite: Sekel sawm toh kikima gik gimlima dim dangkaeng keu khat;
english: one golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense;

paite: Halmang thillat ding bawngtal tuai khat, belamtal khat, belamnou apa kum khata upa khat;
english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

paite: Khelh thoihna ding keltal khat;
english: one male goat for a sin offering;

paite: Huan, lemna kithoih thillat ding bawngtal nih, belamtal nga, keltal nga, belamnou apa kum khata upa nga ahi: hiaite Enan tapa Ahir thillatte ahi.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Ahira the son of Enan.

paite: Huan, maitam thau nilh nia Israel intekpente thillatte dangkasik kuang sawmlenih, dangkasik belhbu sawmlenih, dangkaeng keu sawmlenih ahi.
english: This was the dedication of the altar, on the day when it was anointed, by the princes of Israel: twelve silver platters, twelve silver bowls, twelve golden ladles;

paite: Dangkasik kuang sekel ja leh sawmthum toh kikima gik chiat ahia, belhbu sawmsagih chiat ahi: dangkasik tuiumbelsuan tengteng mun siangthoua sekel sang nih leh za li toh kikima gik ahi;
english: each silver platter weighing one hundred thirty shekels, and each bowl seventy; all the silver of the vessels two thousand four hundred shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary;

paite: Gimlima dim dangkaeng keu sawm leh nih mun siangthoua sekel sawm toh kikima gik chiat ahi: dangkaeng keu tengteng sekel ja leh sawmnih toh kikima gik ahi:
english: the twelve golden ladles, full of incense, weighing ten shekels apiece, after the shekel of the sanctuary; all the gold of the ladles weighed one hundred twenty shekels;

paite: Halmang thillat ding bawngtal tengteng sawm leh nih ahia, belamtal sawmlenih, belamnou apa kum khata upa sawm leh nih, a tangbuang thillatte uh toh; huan, khelhna thoihna ding keltal sawm leh nih:
english: all the cattle for the burnt offering twelve bulls, the rams twelve, the male lambs a year old twelve, and their meal offering; and the male goats for a sin offering twelve;

paite: Huan, lemna kithoihna thillat ding bel bawngtal sawmnih leh li ahia, belamtal bel sawmguk, keltal bel sawmguk, belamnou apa kum khata upa bel sawmguk ahi. Hiai thau nilh khita maitam latna dinga thilpiakte ahi.Huchiin biakbuka amah be dinga Mosi a lutin thukunna bawm tunga chitna tutphah tunglama cherub nihte kikal akipanin amah honhoupihin aw a ja a: huan a beta hi.
english: and all the cattle for the sacrifice of peace offerings twenty-four bulls, the rams sixty, the male goats sixty, the male lambs a year old sixty. This was the dedication of the altar, after it was anointed.

paite: Huchiin biakbuka amah be dinga Mosi a lutin thukunna bawm tunga chitna tutphah tunglama cherub nihte kikal akipanin amah honhoupihin aw a ja a: huan a beta hi.
english: When Moses went into the Tent of Meeting to speak with Yahweh, he heard his voice speaking to him from above the mercy seat that was on the ark of the Testimony, from between the two cherubim: and he spoke to him.
